title: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond
authors_zh: Junteng Liu, Yuanxiang Fan, Zhuo Jiang, Han Ding, Yongyi Hu, Chi Zhang, Yiqi Shi, Shitong Weng, Aili Chen, Shiqi Chen, Yunan Huang, Mozhi Zhang, Pengyu Zhao, Junjie Yan, Junxian He
paper_type_zh: 合成逻辑推理数据发布与 RLVR 构造配方
best_for_zh: 构造可控非数学 RLVR 任务和审计规则奖励的研究者
one_line: SynLogic releases verifier-ready prompts and generator/verifier code for 35 logical tasks, with a 27-task Easy configuration and a 35-task Hard configuration, while online RL rollouts remain unreleased.
SynLogic 开放 35 类逻辑任务的可配置生成器、任务专用验证器和 Easy/Hard RLVR 提示数据，而其修订历史也说明可执行数据仍需版本化审计。
why: It connects task sourcing, rule-based synthesis, model-calibrated difficulty, executable binary rewards, and DAPO-style RL beyond mathematics and code, while its release history illustrates why configuration identity, verifier behavior, and immutable revisions must be audited separately from benchmark gains.
inclusion_reason: SynLogic operationalizes non-mathematical RLVR data construction through configurable logical-task generators, task-specific programmatic verifiers, separate 27-task Easy and 35-task Hard releases, and a documented DAPO-style reward interface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official NeurIPS 2025/OpenReview record, arXiv v4 paper, MiniMax-AI GitHub repository, and MiniMaxAI Hugging Face dataset are the primary sources for this Card. The paper is a NeurIPS 2025 poster. The arXiv record is 2505.19641, and the public repository identifies itself as the official implementation.

RL with verifiable rewards has concentrated on mathematics and code because those domains provide answer checkers, unit tests, and relatively direct binary outcomes. SynLogic addresses a narrower construction gap: how to create a broad logical-reasoning prompt pool whose quantity and difficulty can be controlled and whose final answers can be checked by task-specific rules. The work does not claim that one universal verifier covers logic. It manually encodes different generators, parsers, constraints, and verifiers for tasks such as Sudoku, Cryptarithm, Dyck Language, ARC-AGI, and Zebra Puzzle.

The public data object is a verifier-ready prompt record, not a completed demonstration. Hugging Face exposes Easy and Hard configurations with task identity, one user-role prompt message, an ability label, reward-model fields, and serialized task state in extra_info.game_data_str. During RL, the policy generates 16 responses per prompt online; those accepted and rejected responses, reward outcomes, and training-step decisions are not released. Consequently, the release supports rerunning verifiers and new RL, but it does not reproduce the paper's exact rollout corpus.

Configuration identity is part of the decision boundary. SynLogic-Hard covers all 35 tasks. SynLogic-Easy removes eight tasks that remained at zero 7B training accuracy after difficulty reduction and therefore covers 27. The current release contains 15,837 Easy training rows plus 270 validation rows and 32,840 Hard training rows plus 350 validation rows. A statement that "SynLogic has 35 tasks" describes the framework and Hard configuration, not the Easy training surface.

The work belongs in both programmatically_verifiable_outcome_data and data_construction_open_release_recipes: it publishes rule-checked answer records and an executable construction/reward interface. Its L4 value comes from the explicit data object, task-specific feedback contract, difficulty calibration, optimizer settings, and release audit. Benchmark gains motivate the recipe but do not certify record quality, verifier reliability, provenance, or contamination safety.

本卡以官方NeurIPS 2025/OpenReview条目、arXiv v4论文、MiniMax-AI GitHub仓库和MiniMaxAI Hugging Face数据集为主要来源。该论文以NeurIPS 2025 poster形式接收,arXiv编号为2505.19641,公开仓库明确标为官方实现。

可验证奖励强化学习长期集中于数学与代码,因为这些领域可使用答案检查器、单元测试和相对直接的二元结果。SynLogic处理的是更具体的构造缺口:如何建立一个数量与难度可控、且最终答案可由任务专用规则检查的广泛逻辑推理提示池。该工作并未声称一个通用verifier可以覆盖所有逻辑任务,而是为Sudoku、Cryptarithm、Dyck Language、ARC-AGI、Zebra Puzzle等任务分别人工编码生成器、parser、约束和verifier。

公开数据对象是可交给verifier的提示记录,不是完成后的示范。Hugging Face提供Easy与Hard两种配置,字段包括任务身份、单条user-role提示message、能力标签、reward-model字段,以及extra_info.game_data_str中的序列化任务状态。RL期间,policy对每个提示在线生成16个回答;这些被接受和拒绝的回答、奖励结果与训练步骤决策均未发布。因此,公开对象支持重新运行verifier和开展新的RL,但不能还原论文的精确rollout语料。

配置身份属于判断边界。SynLogic-Hard覆盖全部35项任务。SynLogic-Easy移除了8项在降低难度后仍保持7B训练准确率为零的任务,因此只覆盖27项。当前发布含15,837条Easy训练记录与270条验证记录,以及32,840条Hard训练记录与350条验证记录。"SynLogic有35项任务"描述的是框架和Hard配置,不是Easy训练表面。

该工作同时适合programmatically_verifiable_outcome_data与data_construction_open_release_recipes:它发布规则检查的答案记录和可执行构造/奖励接口。其L4价值来自明确的数据对象、任务专用反馈契约、难度校准、优化设置与发布审计。Benchmark增益可以说明该配方值得研究,但不能认证逐记录质量、verifier可靠性、来源谱系或去污染安全。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SynLogic's central unit is a generator-verifier pair. The authors select 35 task concepts, identify task-specific difficulty parameters, encode constraints in generation code, formalize each instance into natural language, and dispatch a model answer to the corresponding verifier. Thirty-three task families are independently implemented and generated; Zebra Puzzle and ARC-AGI records are adopted from existing open resources. All 35 released task identities have verifier mappings, although the current repository lacks the Cipher question generator reported in an open issue.

Difficulty is calibrated with model solvability rather than a single handcrafted level. DeepSeek R1 and OpenAI-o3-mini set an upper bound at the highest parameter setting for which pass@10 remains above zero. Unspecified chat models set a lower bound at settings with pass rate between zero and 0.5. These models are difficulty probes, not disclosed trace teachers. The exact checkpoints/endpoints, complete prompts, seeds, and decoding settings for this calibration are unknown.

The public record schema contains data_source, prompt, ability, reward_model, and extra_info. prompt is a one-message list with role and content. reward_model exposes answer, solution, and style fields, but public examples and issue discussion show that these fields may be empty. Official training guidance says reward calculation should load extra_info.game_data_str, a serialized task object containing fields such as question, answer, difficulty, and task metadata. The answer may itself be represented differently across tasks, including inside metadata.

The feedback contract is a product of format and correctness. The paper assigns reward 1 only if the response contains the required think/answer structure and its final answer is correct under the task verifier. The repository reference implementation is stricter: the response must start with the opening think tag, end with the closing answer tag, contain each of the four tags exactly once, and then pass the selected verifier after answer extraction. Any failed component makes the final reward zero.

This is answer-level supervision with a binary scalar reward, not step supervision. A successful final answer does not label intermediate reasoning steps, and programmatic acceptance is not evidence that the written reasoning is faithful. The released prompts and verifier state also omit the online responses and reward decisions that actually drive GRPO, so the feedback contract is inspectable but the paper's training trajectory is only partially auditable.

SynLogic的核心单元是generator-verifier配对。作者选择35项任务概念,识别各任务的难度参数,把约束编码进生成代码,将实例形式化为自然语言,再把模型答案分派给对应verifier。33项任务由团队独立实现并生成;Zebra Puzzle与ARC-AGI记录直接采用现有开放资源。全部35个发布任务身份都有verifier映射,但当前仓库缺少一个公开issue所指出的Cipher题目生成器。

难度由模型可解性校准,而不是只依赖一个人工等级。DeepSeek R1与OpenAI-o3-mini给出上界:选择其pass@10仍大于零的最高参数设置。未具名chat模型给出下界:选择通过率位于零到0.5之间的设置。这些模型是难度探针,不是已披露的轨迹教师。其精确checkpoint/endpoint、完整提示、seed和解码设置均为unknown。

公开记录schema包含data_source、prompt、ability、reward_model与extra_info。prompt是由role和content组成的单message列表。reward_model公开answer、solution与style字段,但公开样例和issue讨论表明这些字段可能为空。官方训练指导要求从extra_info.game_data_str加载奖励所需状态;这是包含question、answer、difficulty和任务metadata等字段的序列化任务对象。不同任务的答案表示并不统一,有时会位于metadata内部。

反馈契约是格式与正确性的乘积。论文只有在回答包含规定的think/answer结构、且最终答案通过任务verifier时才给奖励1。仓库参考实现更严格:回答必须以开头think标签起始、以结尾answer标签结束,四个标签各出现一次;完成答案抽取后还必须通过选定verifier。任一组成失败,最终奖励都是零。

这属于答案级监督与二元标量reward,不是步骤监督。最终答案被接受不会给中间推理步骤加标签,程序接受也不能证明写出的推理忠实。发布的提示与verifier状态还省略了真正驱动GRPO的在线回答和奖励决策,因此反馈契约可检查,论文训练轨迹却只能部分审计。

title: Method
方法
html:
Task sourcing begins from two groups: recognized puzzle types from logic communities and task concepts appearing in evaluation suites such as BBH, BBEH, and KOR-Bench. The paper adds other puzzle families, including Mathador and Minesweeper. For each task, the authors identify parameters such as grid size, missing values, density, or constraint count; manually implement rules; generate instances; apply automated correctness and solvability checks; and render task-specific natural-language prompts.

Difficulty control has two model-based bounds. The upper boundary is the most difficult parameter setting still solved at least once in ten attempts by DeepSeek R1 or OpenAI-o3-mini. The lower boundary uses unspecified chat models and retains parameter settings with pass rate above zero and at most 0.5. SynLogic-Hard uses the broader difficulty range for Qwen2.5-32B-Base. After difficulty reduction, Arrow Maze, Goods Exchange, Kukurasu, Minesweeper, Norinori, Object Counting, Space Reasoning Tree, and Wordscapes still produced zero 7B training accuracy and were removed from SynLogic-Easy.

At Hugging Face revision bb4297b82b9c28ef39249f48386cefd5e856618a, Easy has 15,837 train and 270 validation rows across 27 tasks; Hard has 32,840 train and 350 validation rows across 35 tasks. Validation contributes 10 records per included task. Training counts vary by task rather than being a uniform fixed quota. Each row provides the prompt and serialized verifier state, not a target reasoning response. The current public release does not expose policy rollout text, reward logs, rejection reasons, or a deterministic ledger linking a prompt to the 16 sampled responses used at each RL update.

The paper trains Qwen2.5-7B-Base on Easy and Qwen2.5-32B-Base on Hard with DAPO-adapted GRPO. The main runs use prompt batch size 128, group size 16, maximum prompt length 2,048, and 16 rollouts per prompt. The 7B run uses learning rate 1e-6, mini-batch 64, and maximum response length 16,384; the main 32B run uses learning rate 2e-6, mini-batch 16, and maximum response length 28,672. Both report clip-high 0.28 and clip-low 0.2. Sampling temperature is unknown.

Mixed-domain experiments combine SynLogic with 17k DAPO mathematics prompts or about 9k online-platform coding prompts for 7B studies. The large Zero-Mix-3 setting uses 35k mathematics, 9k code, and 17k SynLogic prompts with Qwen2.5-32B-Base; that run uses prompt batch 512 and maximum response length 12,288. Code rewards require format compliance and all tests to pass. These mixtures support the paper's transfer study but do not expand the released SynLogic rows into mathematics or code data.

The official GitHub main revision audited here is d8c527fd17edb739172619efb9b681805fc74b8d, with no tagged release. It publishes generators, verifiers, task2verifier.py, a reward reference, and Verl integration guidance. Reproduction should pin both that code revision and the Hugging Face revision, inspect each task's game_data_str, and test verifier behavior before training; repository availability alone does not establish a fixed end-to-end environment.

任务来源分为两组:逻辑社区中的常见谜题类型,以及BBH、BBEH、KOR-Bench等评估套件中的任务概念。论文还加入Mathador、Minesweeper等其他谜题族。对每项任务,作者识别grid size、缺失值、密度或约束数量等参数,人工实现规则,生成实例,执行自动正确性与可解性检查,再用任务专用模板渲染自然语言提示。

难度控制有两个基于模型的边界。上界是DeepSeek R1或OpenAI-o3-mini在10次尝试中仍至少解出一次的最难参数设置。下界使用未具名chat模型,保留通过率大于零且不超过0.5的参数设置。SynLogic-Hard为Qwen2.5-32B-Base采用更宽难度区间。降低难度后,Arrow Maze、Goods Exchange、Kukurasu、Minesweeper、Norinori、Object Counting、Space Reasoning Tree和Wordscapes仍产生零7B训练准确率,因此从SynLogic-Easy移除。

在Hugging Face revision bb4297b82b9c28ef39249f48386cefd5e856618a上,Easy含27项任务、15,837条训练记录和270条验证记录;Hard含35项任务、32,840条训练记录和350条验证记录。每项纳入任务贡献10条验证记录,训练条数则按任务不同,并非统一定额。每行提供提示和序列化verifier状态,而不是目标推理回答。当前公开发布没有policy rollout文本、奖励日志、拒绝原因,也没有把提示与每次RL更新所用16个采样回答确定连接起来的ledger。

论文用DAPO改造的GRPO,在Easy上训练Qwen2.5-7B-Base,在Hard上训练Qwen2.5-32B-Base。主实验使用prompt batch 128、group size 16、最大提示长度2,048,每个提示16个rollout。7B设置为学习率1e-6、mini-batch 64、最大回答长度16,384;主32B设置为学习率2e-6、mini-batch 16、最大回答长度28,672。两者均报告clip-high 0.28与clip-low 0.2。采样temperature为unknown。

混合领域实验在7B研究中把SynLogic与17k条DAPO数学提示或约9k条在线平台代码提示组合。大规模Zero-Mix-3用Qwen2.5-32B-Base训练35k数学、9k代码与17k SynLogic提示;该运行使用prompt batch 512与最大回答长度12,288。代码奖励要求格式合规且通过全部测试。这些混合数据支持论文的迁移研究,但不会把公开SynLogic行扩展成数学或代码发布。

本次审计的官方GitHub main revision为d8c527fd17edb739172619efb9b681805fc74b8d,且没有tagged release。仓库发布生成器、verifier、task2verifier.py、奖励参考与Verl集成指导。复现时应同时固定该代码revision与Hugging Face revision,检查每项任务的game_data_str,并在训练前测试verifier行为;仓库可访问本身不能建立固定的端到端环境。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The release evidence first establishes what exists. The current Hugging Face API reports two configurations and four files: Easy and Hard train/validation Parquet files. Dataset statistics show 27 data_source values in Easy train and 35 in Hard train, with 15,837 and 32,840 rows respectively. The validation sizes, 270 and 350, agree with 10 records per included task. The public schema exposes data_source, prompt, ability, reward_model, and extra_info; sampled rows confirm that reward_model fields can be empty while game_data_str carries task state. At pinned revision bb4297b82b9c28ef39249f48386cefd5e856618a, 48 of the first 100 Hard train rows returned by the official Dataset Server contain visibly mojibaked Chinese in both prompt content and serialized verifier state; all 100 sampled rows are Campsite, so this is direct evidence of an encoding defect in that slice, not an estimate for the whole release.

For logic-only RL, Table 2 reports SynLogic-7B at 44.4 on SynLogic-Easy validation, 48.1 on KOR-Bench, 66.5 on BBH, and 8.0 on BBEH. SynLogic-32B reports 52.9 on SynLogic-Hard validation, 62.2 on KOR-Bench, 85.8 on BBH, and 25.5 on BBEH. The 32B score exceeds the table's R1-Distill-Qwen-32B BBEH value of 19.2, while remaining below that model on KOR-Bench and BBH. These are trained-model benchmark outcomes, not direct measurements of dataset correctness or verifier error.

The same table reports cross-domain mathematics changes relative to base models. SynLogic-7B moves from 0.3 to 10.0 on AIME 2024, from 64.6 to 71.8 on MATH 500, and from 30.0 to 55.0 on AMC 2023. SynLogic-32B moves from 4.5 to 19.6, 68.6 to 82.0, and 45.0 to 57.5 on those benchmarks. Comparisons to instruction-tuned and distilled models are mixed, so the evidence supports transfer from the studied RL setup rather than universal superiority.

The mixed-data evidence separates the SynLogic contribution from a math-plus-code control. Table 3 reports Zero-Mix-3 at 28.6 BBEH, 65.0 KOR-Bench, 40.7 LiveCodeBench, 35.8 AIME 2024, and 57.5 GPQA-Diamond, versus Zero-Mix-2 at 18.5, 58.6, 39.5, 34.5, and 55.2. Both configurations run for the same number of training steps, but the mixtures contain different data. The result motivates studying logical prompts in cross-domain RL; it does not isolate every possible data-volume, sampling, or optimizer confounder.

Artifact history provides separate audit evidence. GitHub commit d2e6cf93042a2713fdd833f5e5e071ac3d8ab901 fixes a Boolean Expressions repetition bug. Hugging Face commits remove duplicate Easy prompts and duplicate ARC-AGI prompts and later fix Boolean Expressions. An open GitHub issue reports that the Cipher question generator is missing. These records demonstrate that the executable dataset changed after release and that exact revision identity matters.

None of these results calibrates all 35 verifiers, proves the absence of semantic contamination, validates upstream license compatibility, or certifies unreleased rollouts. Benchmark performance is evidence that the training recipe affected studied models; it is not evidence that every public row is correct or that the released object is a complete account of training data.

发布证据首先说明哪些对象确实存在。当前Hugging Face API报告Easy与Hard两种配置和四个文件,即两种配置各自的train/validation Parquet文件。数据统计显示Easy train有27个data_source值与15,837行,Hard train有35个值与32,840行。验证集大小分别为270与350,与每项纳入任务10条记录一致。公开schema包含data_source、prompt、ability、reward_model和extra_info;抽样记录确认reward_model字段可能为空,而game_data_str承载任务状态。在固定revision bb4297b82b9c28ef39249f48386cefd5e856618a上,官方Dataset Server返回的前100条Hard train记录均为Campsite,其中48条在提示内容和序列化verifier状态中都出现明显中文乱码。这直接证明该切片存在编码缺陷,但不能据此估计整个发布的受影响比例。

对仅逻辑RL,表2报告SynLogic-7B在SynLogic-Easy验证集、KOR-Bench、BBH和BBEH上分别为44.4、48.1、66.5和8.0。SynLogic-32B在SynLogic-Hard验证集、KOR-Bench、BBH和BBEH上分别为52.9、62.2、85.8和25.5。32B的BBEH分数高于表中R1-Distill-Qwen-32B的19.2,但在KOR-Bench和BBH上低于后者。这些是训练后模型的benchmark结果,不是数据集正确性或verifier误差的直接测量。

同一表格还报告相对base模型的跨领域数学变化。SynLogic-7B在AIME 2024上从0.3升至10.0,在MATH 500上从64.6升至71.8,在AMC 2023上从30.0升至55.0。SynLogic-32B在对应benchmark上从4.5升至19.6、68.6升至82.0、45.0升至57.5。与instruction-tuned和distilled模型的比较有升有降,因此证据支持研究设置中的RL迁移,而不是普遍优越性。

混合数据证据把SynLogic贡献与math-plus-code控制分开。表3报告Zero-Mix-3在BBEH、KOR-Bench、LiveCodeBench、AIME 2024和GPQA-Diamond上分别为28.6、65.0、40.7、35.8和57.5;Zero-Mix-2分别为18.5、58.6、39.5、34.5和55.2。两种配置运行相同步数,但其混合数据不同。结果支持研究逻辑提示在跨领域RL中的作用,却没有隔离所有数据量、采样或optimizer混杂因素。

Artifact历史提供另一类审计证据。GitHub commit d2e6cf93042a2713fdd833f5e5e071ac3d8ab901修复Boolean Expressions重复bug。Hugging Face commits移除Easy重复提示与ARC-AGI重复提示,随后又修复Boolean Expressions。一个仍开放的GitHub issue指出Cipher题目生成器缺失。这些记录说明可执行数据集在发布后发生变化,精确revision身份很重要。

以上结果都没有校准全部35个verifier,没有证明不存在语义污染,没有验证上游许可证兼容,也不能认证未发布rollout。Benchmark表现能说明该训练配方影响了研究中的模型,但不能证明每条公开记录都正确,也不能证明公开对象完整记录了训练数据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is mostly fixed evaluation data or narrow trainable logic tasks. In the paper's Table 1, BBH and BBEH cover 23 tasks but do not supply trainable, adjustable-difficulty data; Zebra Logic and K&K offer adjustable difficulty for one task, and K&K is trainable. SynLogic's specific change is to turn a wider set of 35 logical-task concepts into a common construction pattern with task-specific generation, natural-language formalization, difficulty parameters, and executable answer verification.

The direction signal is not merely the task count. The paper connects three layers that are often separated: model-calibrated prompt generation, a verifier-selected binary reward, and online GRPO on base models. It then provides Easy and Hard surfaces matched to different model capacities and studies mixtures with mathematics and code. For reasoning-data curation, this makes configuration choice, verifier identity, and model solvability part of the dataset definition rather than incidental experimental details.

The release also exposes a useful distinction between a prompt dataset and an RL experience dataset. Public rows contain prompt and reward state, while the 16 online responses per prompt and their reward outcomes remain absent. This makes the artifact reusable for fresh RL but prevents direct audit of the policy behavior that produced the paper's updates. Treating this missing decision lineage as part of the data object is an important audit lesson, even though the paper itself emphasizes scalability.

What is not new should remain explicit. SynLogic does not introduce GRPO, DAPO, binary outcome rewards, synthetic puzzles, answer parsing, or benchmark-based difficulty measurement. Thirty-three tasks are independently generated, but two use existing resources, and many task concepts are drawn from prior puzzle communities or benchmarks. The official repository's missing Cipher generator also means the published implementation is not a complete generator set for all framework tasks.

A sound reuse comparison should match prompt counts, task mixture, difficulty band, verifier revision, rollout budget, response length, and optimizer settings. It should include task-specific parser tests, a no-logic or alternative-logic mixture, and contamination checks. Downstream benchmark deltas are useful direction evidence only after these construction variables are separated from model and compute changes.

既有基线大多是固定评估数据或范围较窄的可训练逻辑任务。论文表1中,BBH与BBEH各覆盖23项任务,但不提供可训练、难度可调的数据;Zebra Logic与K&K各在单项任务上提供难度调整,其中K&K可训练。SynLogic的具体变化是把更广的35项逻辑任务概念实现为共同构造模式,同时保留任务专用生成、自然语言形式化、难度参数和可执行答案验证。

方向信号并不只是任务数量。论文连接了常被分开的三个层次:由模型校准的提示生成、由verifier决定的二元reward,以及base模型上的在线GRPO。随后,它提供与不同模型容量匹配的Easy和Hard表面,并研究与数学、代码混合。对推理数据策展而言,这使配置选择、verifier身份和模型可解性成为数据集定义的一部分,而不是附带实验细节。

该发布还揭示了提示数据集与RL经验数据集的区别。公开行包含提示与奖励状态,但每个提示的16个在线回答及其奖励结果均缺失。这使artifact可用于新的RL,却无法直接审计产生论文更新的policy行为。即便论文主要强调可扩展性,把这段缺失的决策lineage视为数据对象的一部分仍是重要审计结论。

必须明确哪些不是新贡献。SynLogic没有提出GRPO、DAPO、二元结果reward、合成谜题、答案parser或基于benchmark的难度测量。33项任务由团队独立生成,但2项采用现有资源,而且许多任务概念来自既有谜题社区或benchmark。官方仓库缺少Cipher生成器,也意味着发布实现并非框架全部任务的完整生成器集合。

可靠复用比较应匹配提示数量、任务混合、难度区间、verifier revision、rollout预算、回答长度与optimizer设置,并加入逐任务parser测试、无逻辑或替代逻辑混合控制,以及去污染检查。只有把这些构造变量与模型、计算变化分离后,下游benchmark差值才能作为方向证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Easy and Hard are not interchangeable difficulty labels over the same task set. Easy removes eight tasks and exposes 27 data_source values; Hard exposes all 35. Dataset statistics, verifier coverage, and model claims must name the configuration.
  • The public object is prompt-plus-verifier state. It does not release the 16 online policy responses per prompt, accepted/rejected sets, format scores, correctness scores, advantages, or training-step linkage, so the paper's RL experience data cannot be replayed exactly.
  • reward_model.answer, reward_model.solution, and reward_model.style are public schema fields but can be empty. Official guidance uses extra_info.game_data_str; task answers may live in different nested locations, and a generic loader can silently score against the wrong field.
  • The paper's format description is less strict than the repository reward reference. The code requires exact start/end placement and exactly one copy of every tag. A formatting difference can therefore zero the reward before logical correctness is checked.
  • Programmatic does not mean infallible. Each task has its own answer extraction and verification logic, but no released task-level error rates, adversarial suites, ambiguity labels, or human adjudication set calibrates false positives and false negatives.
  • The authors report no identical generated samples in benchmark test sets, but near-duplicate, semantic, template, and adopted-resource overlap are unknown. No released match/removal ledger covers KOR-Bench, BBH, BBEH, ARC-AGI, Zebra Puzzle, or the mathematics/code evaluations.
  • Difficulty calibration is only partially specified. DeepSeek R1 and OpenAI-o3-mini are named, but exact versions/endpoints, calibration prompts, seeds, and decoding settings are unknown; lower-bound chat models are not named.
  • The current GitHub repository has no tagged release. Hugging Face history records duplicate and Boolean Expressions repairs, and GitHub issue 6 reports a missing Cipher question generator. Reusing mutable main without hashes can change rows or executable behavior.
  • The pinned Hard release has an observed text-integrity defect: 48 of the first 100 Dataset Server rows, all from Campsite, contain mojibaked Chinese in both the prompt and game_data_str. The affected share across tasks/configurations and whether parsing or reward behavior changes are unknown.
  • Repository and dataset metadata state MIT, and OpenReview states CC BY 4.0 for the paper, but record-level upstream source identity, attribution, and license compatibility for adopted and benchmark-inspired tasks are incomplete.
  • The 7B and 32B studies use different data configurations, response limits, batches, and model capacities. Mixed-domain studies also change task mixture. Benchmark differences cannot be attributed to data quality alone.
  • The paper reports answer-level binary rewards, not process labels. Verifier success does not establish that intermediate reasoning is faithful, concise, safe, or pedagogically useful.
  • Reproducibility remains partial because sampling temperature, complete software/dependency versions, infrastructure details, random seeds, and the exact rollout corpus are unknown.

• Easy与Hard不是同一任务集上的可互换难度标签。Easy移除8项任务,只公开27个data_source值;Hard公开全部35项。数据统计、verifier覆盖与模型结论都必须注明配置。
  • 公开对象是提示加verifier状态,不含每个提示16个在线policy回答、接受/拒绝集合、格式分数、正确性分数、advantage或训练步骤连接,因此无法精确重放论文的RL经验数据。
  • reward_model.answer、reward_model.solution与reward_model.style是公开schema字段,但可能为空。官方指导使用extra_info.game_data_str;不同任务的答案可能位于不同嵌套位置,通用loader可能在无提示下读取错误字段。
  • 论文的格式描述比仓库奖励参考宽松。代码要求精确起止位置,且每个标签只能出现一次。因此,格式差异可能在逻辑正确性检查前就把奖励置零。
  • 程序化不等于不会出错。每项任务都有自己的答案抽取与验证逻辑,但没有公开逐任务误差率、对抗测试集、歧义标签或人工裁决集来校准假阳性与假阴性。
  • 作者报告生成样本与benchmark测试集之间没有完全相同记录,但近重复、语义、模板和采用资源的重叠均为unknown。没有公开的匹配/移除ledger覆盖KOR-Bench、BBH、BBEH、ARC-AGI、Zebra Puzzle或数学/代码评估。
  • 难度校准只被部分披露。论文具名DeepSeek R1与OpenAI-o3-mini,但精确版本/endpoint、校准提示、seed与解码设置均为unknown;下界chat模型未具名。
  • 当前GitHub仓库没有tagged release。Hugging Face历史记录了重复与Boolean Expressions修复,GitHub issue 6还报告Cipher题目生成器缺失。复用未固定hash的main可能改变行内容或可执行行为。
  • 固定的Hard发布存在已观察到的文本完整性缺陷:Dataset Server前100条记录均来自Campsite,其中48条在提示和game_data_str中都出现中文乱码。各任务/配置的受影响比例,以及该问题是否改变parser或reward行为,均为unknown。
  • 仓库和数据集metadata标为MIT,OpenReview将论文标为CC BY 4.0,但采用任务与benchmark启发任务的逐记录上游来源身份、归属和许可证兼容仍不完整。
  • 7B与32B研究采用不同数据配置、回答长度、batch与模型容量;混合领域研究还改变任务mixture。Benchmark差异不能只归因于数据质量。
  • 论文提供答案级二元reward,不提供过程标签。通过verifier不能证明中间推理忠实、简洁、安全或适合教学。
  • 采样temperature、完整软件/依赖版本、基础设施细节、随机seed和精确rollout语料均为unknown,因此复现仍然不完整。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For programmatically_verifiable_outcome_data, SynLogic is a concrete example of a heterogeneous verifier suite. A reusable record should preserve the configuration, data_source, prompt index, complete game_data_str, generator revision, verifier revision, parser behavior, and expected answer representation. Verifier tests should include malformed formatting, alternative but equivalent answers, adversarial strings, ambiguous cases, timeouts, task-specific normalization, and multilingual Unicode round trips rather than assuming a binary function is correct.

For data_construction_open_release_recipes, the framework provides a practical sequence: select tasks, define difficulty parameters, implement generators, check correctness and solvability, calibrate learnability with model pass rates, render prompts, attach task verifiers, and train with online RL. Builders can reuse this pattern for non-mathematical domains, but they should publish a complete provenance and decision ledger instead of only final prompts.

An auditable prompt record should add source concept, upstream resource ID and license, generator parameters and seed, validation checks, difficulty-probe models and exact settings, template revision, and deduplication results. An auditable rollout record should add policy checkpoint, rendered input, sampling settings, response, extracted answer, format result, verifier result, final reward, rejection reason, training step, and optimizer context. SynLogic publishes much of the first layer but not the second.

The Easy/Hard distinction can support curriculum and capacity studies if treated as two explicit task surfaces. Researchers can test whether exclusions caused by zero 7B training accuracy reflect true capacity limits, reward sparsity, parser failures, or poor parameter ranges. They can also compare task-balanced sampling against the uneven released row counts and inspect whether model-calibrated difficulty transfers to other checkpoints.

The release is also useful for verifier robustness and versioning research. Post-release fixes supply real examples of duplicate prompts and generator/data defects, while the missing Cipher generator exposes a regeneration gap. Pinning d8c527fd17edb739172619efb9b681805fc74b8d and bb4297b82b9c28ef39249f48386cefd5e856618a gives a starting audit snapshot, not a guarantee that every task is correct.

For training, use SynLogic directly for RLVR or evaluation after task-level checks. It is not an SFT response dataset: no target policy trajectories are provided. If constructing SFT or distillation data, generate and independently verify responses, retain rejected candidates, and document the new authoring model and filters. Benchmark improvements can justify experimentation, but the transformed corpus needs its own quality, contamination, and license audit.

对programmatically_verifiable_outcome_data而言,SynLogic是异构verifier套件的具体案例。可复用记录应保留配置、data_source、提示index、完整game_data_str、generator revision、verifier revision、parser行为与预期答案表示。Verifier测试应包含格式损坏、等价替代答案、对抗字符串、歧义案例、timeout、任务专用归一化和多语言Unicode往返,而不能因函数输出二元值就假定其正确。

对data_construction_open_release_recipes而言,该框架提供实用流程:选择任务、定义难度参数、实现生成器、检查正确性与可解性、用模型通过率校准可学习性、渲染提示、连接任务verifier,再执行在线RL。构建者可以把该模式复用于非数学领域,但应发布完整来源与决策ledger,而不只发布最终提示。

可审计提示记录还应加入来源概念、上游资源ID与许可证、生成参数与seed、有效性检查、难度探针模型及精确设置、模板revision和去重结果。可审计rollout记录则应加入policy checkpoint、渲染后输入、采样设置、回答、抽取答案、格式结果、verifier结果、最终reward、拒绝原因、训练步骤和optimizer上下文。SynLogic公开了第一层的许多内容,却没有公开第二层。

若把Easy与Hard视为两个明确任务表面,其差异可支持curriculum与容量研究。研究者可以检验因7B训练准确率为零而移除任务,究竟反映真实容量限制、reward稀疏、parser失败还是参数区间不当;还可比较任务均衡采样与发布中不均匀的行数,并检验由模型校准的难度能否迁移到其他checkpoint。

该发布也适合verifier稳健性与版本研究。发布后修复提供重复提示和生成器/数据缺陷的真实案例,缺失Cipher生成器则暴露再生成缺口。固定d8c527fd17edb739172619efb9b681805fc74b8d与bb4297b82b9c28ef39249f48386cefd5e856618a能建立审计起点,但不能保证每项任务都正确。

训练时,可在完成逐任务检查后把SynLogic用于RLVR或评估。它不是SFT回答数据集,因为没有提供目标policy轨迹。若要构造SFT或蒸馏数据,应另行生成并独立验证回答,保留拒绝候选,并记录新的authoring model与filter。Benchmark增益可以支持开展实验,但转换后的语料仍需独立执行质量、污染与许可证审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read "35 tasks" as the framework and Hard configuration; Easy contains 27 after eight zero-accuracy tasks are removed.
  • The released rows are prompts plus serialized verifier state, not teacher demonstrations or the 16 online policy rollouts used per prompt.
  • Public reward_model fields may be empty; official guidance computes rewards from extra_info.game_data_str and task identity.
  • Final reward is binary format multiplied by task correctness; the repository reference enforces stricter tag placement and counts than the prose summary suggests.
  • DeepSeek R1 and OpenAI-o3-mini calibrate difficulty upper bounds rather than response traces, while lower-bound model identities and full settings remain unknown; pin both GitHub and Hugging Face hashes because fixes changed the release, the Cipher generator is missing, sampled Hard Campsite rows expose Chinese mojibake, and Tables 2–3 are downstream evidence rather than proof of data quality.

• "35项任务"指框架与Hard配置;Easy在移除8项零准确率任务后只含27项。
  • 发布行是提示加序列化verifier状态,不是教师示范,也不是每个提示用于训练的16个在线policy rollout。
  • 公开reward_model字段可能为空;官方指导依据extra_info.game_data_str和任务身份计算奖励。
  • 最终reward是二元格式结果乘以任务正确性;仓库参考对标签位置与数量的要求比论文文字摘要更严格。
  • DeepSeek R1与OpenAI-o3-mini用于校准难度上界而非生成回答轨迹,下界模型身份与完整设置仍为unknown;同时固定GitHub与Hugging Face hash,因为修复已经改变发布、Cipher生成器仍缺失、抽样Hard Campsite行暴露中文乱码,且表2至表3只是下游训练证据,不是数据质量证明。

value.html: The paper selects 35 logical-reasoning tasks from community puzzles and benchmark task concepts. The authors independently implement and generate 33 task families; Zebra Puzzle and ARC-AGI use existing open resources.

Each released row contains a data_source identifier, one user-role prompt message, an ability label, reward_model answer/solution/style fields, and extra_info. The embedded instruction requests think and answer tags, while individual tasks may impose additional output formats.
Online Qwen2.5 policy responses are sampled during RL. The public Hugging Face release contains prompts and verifier state, not accepted or rejected policy reasoning trajectories.
Task-specific rule-based generators and verifiers provide the data and reward substrate. DAPO-adapted GRPO generates online policy responses against Easy or Hard prompts during training.

The paper defines a binary reward that is 1 only when the response satisfies the required think/answer format and the extracted final answer passes the selected task verifier. The repository reference implementation multiplies a strict format check by the task-verifier result and loads verifier state from extra_info.game_data_str.

A response receives final reward 1 only if it starts and ends with the prescribed tagged structure, contains each required tag exactly once under the reference implementation, and its extracted answer is accepted by the task-specific verifier; otherwise the reward is 0.
Qwen2.5-7B-Base is trained on SynLogic-Easy; Qwen2.5-32B-Base is trained on SynLogic-Hard and in the large mixed-domain experiment.

DeepSeek R1 and OpenAI-o3-mini are used to set difficulty upper bounds, while unspecified chat models set lower bounds. These models calibrate solvability and are not disclosed as response-trace teachers.

Manually implemented rule-based generators produce 33 task families, while Zebra Puzzle and ARC-AGI data are adopted from existing open resources. The current official repository exposes task verifiers for all released data sources, but an open issue reports that the Cipher question-generation script is absent.

The current Hugging Face revision contains 15,837 Easy training rows plus 270 validation rows and 32,840 Hard training rows plus 350 validation rows. Paper experiments use prompt batches of 128 and generate 16 online rollouts per prompt; those rollouts are not part of the public dataset.
unknown

Generated instances undergo automatic correctness and solvability checks. Difficulty parameters are bounded by model pass behavior; eight tasks with zero 7B training accuracy after difficulty reduction are excluded from SynLogic-Easy.

Difficulty upper bounds require DeepSeek R1 or OpenAI-o3-mini pass@10 greater than zero. Main RL response limits are 16,384 tokens for 7B and 28,672 for 32B; the large 32B mixed run uses 12,288. Evaluation uses task-dependent pass@1, avg@4, or avg@8.

DAPO-adapted GRPO. The paper reports learning rates of 1e-6 for 7B and 2e-6 for 32B, GRPO group size 16, maximum prompt length 2,048, clip-high 0.28, and clip-low 0.2; the repository supplies Verl integration guidance rather than a pinned end-to-end training environment.

Thirty-three independently implemented logical-task families plus Zebra Puzzle and ARC-AGI records adopted from existing open resources. Difficulty-control parameters and answer representations differ by task.

SynLogic-Easy has 27 tasks because Arrow Maze, Goods Exchange, Kukurasu, Minesweeper, Norinori, Object Counting, Space Reasoning Tree, and Wordscapes are removed; its current release has 15,837 train and 270 validation rows. SynLogic-Hard covers all 35 tasks with 32,840 train and 350 validation rows. Each validation split has 10 rows per included task.

The authors report no identical samples between generated datasets and benchmark test sets. Near-duplicate, semantic, template, and adopted-resource overlap checks are unknown, and no match/removal ledger is released.

items: {'Easy and Hard are different task surfaces': 'Easy exposes 27 task identifiers and Hard exposes 35. Reporting only the framework-wide number can misdescribe the released configuration used for 7B training.'}

Public rows expose prompts and verifier state but not online policy responses, format/accuracy rewards, accepted/rejected rollouts, or per-step training decisions; the RL dataset cannot be reconstructed from prompts alone.

reward_model.answer, reward_model.solution, and reward_model.style exist in the public schema but can be empty. Official guidance says reward computation should load extra_info.game_data_str, whose task-specific answer and metadata layout must be inspected.

{'The paper reward description and repository reference implementation differ in strictness': 'the code requires exact boundary placement and exactly one occurrence of each tag before invoking the task verifier.'}
Parser and verifier bugs can create false positive or false negative rewards. The release does not publish task-level verifier accuracy, adversarial tests, ambiguity sets, or calibrated error rates.
Hugging Face history records post-release duplicate and Boolean Expressions repairs, so mutable main can change row content. GitHub also has no tagged release.

In an official Dataset Server sample of the first 100 SynLogic-Hard train rows at the pinned revision, all rows are Campsite and 48 contain visibly mojibaked Chinese in both prompt content and serialized verifier state; prevalence elsewhere and impact on training or verification are unknown.

The official repository contains a Cipher verifier but an open issue reports that the corresponding question-generation script is missing, preventing full regeneration of that task from the repository alone.
Exact-match comparison does not rule out semantic or template contamination, especially where task concepts overlap KOR-Bench, BBH, or BBEH or where ARC-AGI and Zebra Puzzle resources are adopted.
Difficulty thresholds depend on named frontier models and unspecified chat models, but endpoint/checkpoint versions, complete prompts, seeds, and all decoding settings are unknown.
Benchmark improvements measure downstream trained models, not record correctness, verifier robustness, release completeness, license compatibility, or data quality.

The audited GitHub main revision is d8c527fd17edb739172619efb9b681805fc74b8d and has no tagged release. The audited Hugging Face revision is bb4297b82b9c28ef39249f48386cefd5e856618a. Dataset commits document Easy duplicate removal, ARC-AGI duplicate-prompt removal, and a Boolean Expressions fix after initial publication.
